tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows provide varied u_now and x_now values at horizons near the requested forecast horizon, sufficient to fit the two-parameter coarse adiabatic relaxation hypothesis without another measurement. Fit its effective equilibrium scale and decay rate numerically.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations span distinct inputs and horizons and support fitting the two-parameter coarse adiabatic relaxation law; no residual evidence yet establishes an identifiability gap.
Its response depends only on u_now and H, while the pilot signatures specifically indicate a damped transient and the supplied x_now varies substantially.
It cannot represent the observed fast-transient signature; prefer the coarse relaxation form that includes x_now and decays over H.
The observations are near-linear in u_now and include damped-transient evidence, unlike this proposed relaxation-viscosity law.
